decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with a dedicated page and clear fit to the firm's core formwork-related business, it is likely still above internal attention and worth keeping while early-market feedback accumulates.

Because it was only mentioned rather than fully featured, its commitment level looks lower, but as a recent automation-related launch in the firm's machinery domain it would usually be retained for another year unless results clearly fall below aspiration.

This product appears to have weaker market emphasis than the main launches, yet an established medium-sized German machinery firm would typically use available slack to continue testing such a closely related niche item before dropping it.

Its own product page suggests stronger strategic commitment, and for a mature Mittelstand manufacturer this supports keeping the product on the market while learning from initial sales and customer adoption.

A dedicated page indicates meaningful commitment, and since it complements the firm's existing formwork and magnetic systems portfolio, management would likely keep it unless early performance is clearly disappointing.

Although only mentioned on the website and therefore easier to withdraw than the more prominently promoted launches, it is still new and close enough to the core business that management would likely continue it for now.
